From the manufacturer

Big Student Backpack

The big news with Big Student is that it now features a dedicated 15in padded laptop compartment. You still get two large main compartments, front utility pocket with organizer, pleated front stash pocket and zippered front stash pocket keeps all your gear organized. Choose from dozens of fabrics and colors.

Express Yourself

With over 35 colors, prints and patterns to choose from, you’re sure to find a favorite.

Pack It All In

This pack carries everything you need and more, with extra-large capacity and big, roomy pockets.

All Day Comfort

Slip into S-curve shoulder straps and a padded back panel. This pack doesn’t quit when it comes to comfort.

Everything In Its Place

Keep things under control with two large, zippered compartments, front utility pocket and organizer panel.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Very durable and excellent
    I got this JanSport backpack in Dust Blue, and the it looks exactly like the pictures. It’s really durable and surprisingly roomy. the main and front pockets are very deep, so you can fit a lot of books and other stuff. It only has one side pocket for a water bottle, and the straps are pretty firm at first, so they take a little time to adjust and feel comfortable. It also washes really well in the washing machine, and stains come out easily. It might be a little big for smaller kids in elementary or early middle school since it sits pretty high on the shoulders. Overall, I really like it. It arrived even earlier than expected, feels like it will last a long time, and is definitely worth the money.

    • Shanese Edwards Nevers
      4 out of 5 stars
      Big and spacious
      Reviewed in the United States on July 30, 2026
      Color: Bad BowsSize: One Size
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      If you’re looking for a backpack that can handle everything, this JanSport Big Laptop Backpack is definitely worth checking out.

      What I love most is the amount of space. It has two large main compartments, a dedicated padded sleeve that fits up to a 15-inch laptop, plus multiple front pockets to keep all of your smaller essentials organized. There’s even a side pocket for your water bottle, so everything has its place.

      The quality is good, and it’s made with durable recycled materials that feel sturdy for everyday use, whether you’re heading to school, college, work, or traveling. The ergonomic S-curve shoulder straps and fully padded back panel also make it comfortable to wear, even when it’s packed full.

      One thing I am a little concerned about is the weight limit. Since this isn’t made from the thick, heavy-duty material of the original classic JanSport backpacks, I’m not sure how well it would hold up if you constantly overload it with very heavy books or gear. For everyday essentials like a laptop, notebooks, and personal items, it should be perfectly fine, but I probably wouldn’t recommend stuffing it with excessive weight on a regular basis.

      Overall, if you need a spacious, comfortable, and well-organized backpack for everyday use, I think this is a great option. And with over 35 colors and patterns available, there’s a style for just about everyone. You can find it linked right here on my Amazon storefront.

      This JanSport backpack has exceeded my expectations. The color is vibrant and true to the product photos, and it doesn't look faded or off-tone in person. The overall build quality is impressive - the fabric feels durable and water-resistant, the zippers glide smoothly, and the stitching along the seams looks reinforced and well done, so it should hold up to daily wear and tear.

      What stood out most is the 2-compartment design. The main compartment is spacious enough for books, folders, and everyday essentials, while the dedicated laptop compartment is padded and keeps the laptop secure and separate from other items, which gives extra peace of mind when carrying it around. The ergonomic shoulder straps are cushioned and comfortable even after wearing the bag for extended periods, and the weight is distributed well so it doesn't dig into the shoulders.

      Overall, this is a well-made, functional, and good-looking backpack that combines style with practicality. It's great for school, work, or travel, and I'd definitely recommend it to anyone who needs a reliable bag with good organization and a nice aesthetic.

    About this Item

    • THE MOST TRUSTED NAME IN BACKPACKS - Every JanSport comes with a lifetime warranty. Carry your JanSport with confidence, knowing we'll replace or repair any breaks

    Product Description

    The big news with Big Student is that it now features a dedicated 15in padded laptop compartment. You still get two large main compartments, front utility pocket with organizer, pleated front stash pocket and zippered front stash pocket keeps all your gear organized. Choose from dozens of fabrics and colors. Go Big or go home.
